summary: Senti Biosciences Holdings filed an Item 8.01 8-K reporting that its virtual 2026 Annual Meeting convened on October 8, 2026, and was adjourned without conducting business despite a quorum, to allow more time to solicit votes for the Merger Agreement Proposal described in its September 24, 2026 definitive proxy statement. The meeting reconvenes October 15, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Pacific; record date remains September 23, 2026 and polls stay open. This is a routine meeting adjournment notice, not itself a special-situation event; the underlying merger vote is the item to watch.
